found.quote: It is acceptable to ask Gen AI tools to provide feedback and suggest improvements to your own written work.
Gen AI tools are great at helping kick start a thought process or to generate ideas for a topic for discussion.
In all summative assessment you must check to see if the use of generative AI has been explicitly permitted in your assignment brief.
If in doubt about using a Generative AI tool, please ask your tutor for further advice and support.
In each case, the specific use of AI will be explicitly mentioned in the assignment brief.
Attempting to pass off work generated by Gen AI tools as your own work.
Any use of examples 4a-4c from the table below without explicit mention in the assignment brief may lead to your submission being flagged for potential academic misconduct.
Students may be given access to Generative AI tools through an institutional licence, and this will be accessed through Single Sign On (SSO) using BPP credentials where it is granted.
The Generative AI Awareness HUB course outlines the importance of maintaining the integrity of BPP Intellectual Property (IP), the confidentiality of BPP and Client Data
ensuring that we comply with GDPR regulations and data protection protocols.

unsure.quote: You must not use AI to generate copy where your real-time oral speaking skills are being assessed.
unsure.why: Forbids generating content for one assessment type; overlaps whole-assessment ban.

unsure.quote: Apprentices who are on Degree Apprenticeships are permitted to use generative AI in assessments leading to module completion and module credit.
unsure.why: Permits AI in assessments but does not say output may be submitted.

unsure.quote: Translating content to or from English, excluding any personal, client or business confidential content
unsure.why: Listed as acceptable with confidentiality limit; translation not main restriction.

unsure.quote: Acceptable use only if explicitly mentioned in assignment brief
unsure.why: Three-category tables exist but no named tier scheme is described.

unsure.quote: the integrity of BPP Intellectual Property (IP), the confidentiality of BPP and Client Data
unsure.why: Describes course content on IP; no explicit upload prohibition.

unsure.quote: Copying and pasting from Generative AI tools shows no skill, understanding or processing of information.
unsure.why: Rationale for banning copy-paste, not normative support-not-replace statement.
